datasets.title: KNMI TEMIS daily UV (uvief, uvdec, uvdvc, uvddc), raw HDF4 files, 2013-2019
datasets.provider: KNMI / ESA, Tropospheric Emission Monitoring Internet Service (TEMIS)
datasets.license: Free use with credits; redistribution not granted
datasets.redistribution: not granted: neither the raw HDF files nor the converted parquet may be redistributed; every site downloads and converts its own copy

terms.summary: Download from KNMI yourself; do not share the files or values derived from them without KNMI's permission.
terms.license: TEMIS data policy (credit KNMI/ESA); no redistribution grant

instructions: Download the daily files {var}YYYYMMDD.hdf for var in uvief, uvdec, uvdvc, uvddc and the years 2013-2019 (about 10,220 files, about 31.6 GB) from the KNMI archive; the mirror https://d1qb6yzwaaq4he.cloudfront.net/uvradiation/v2.0/{year}/{mm}/{var}YYYYMMDD.hdf serves the same files.
2016-02-29 is missing upstream for all four variables; that gap is expected.
Reading needs the hdf4 extra (pyhdf). The first run converts the files to <data_dir>/TEMIS/C4/converted/, so the data directory must be writable then.
datasets.next: manual download from the provider; see instructions
